_comment: Historical Pre-Alpha epics, snapshotted from ChroniclesOfNesis/tickets/epics.json. Pre-Alpha shipped before the bd migration; this file preserves the epic list for the Completed section of /test/tickets/. All entries marked status=closed per owner direction (the milestone is complete regardless of any individual epic's mid-flight state at migration time). Replace with bd-migrated entries when Arc backfills.

epics.title: Save/Load Menu Full Feature
epics.description: Get save and load menus working end-to-end with visual polish, screenshot persistence, play time tracking, and post-load gameplay verification.

epics.title: Laria Town Experience
epics.description: Core town systems: inventory from treasure chests, character status view, graceful menu states. Shop is a separate epic.

epics.title: Shop & Economy
epics.description: Port shop system for GeneralStore. Buy/sell items with currency.

epics.title: Menu System Polish
epics.description: Port ConsumeItemMenu, implement unified WASD+mouse navigation, fix menu bugs.

epics.title: Visual Polish & Rendering Fixes
epics.description: Fix sprite rendering issues (fuzzy NPCs, filter settings).

epics.title: Event System Web Compatibility
epics.description: Get all intro events (1-8) running in the web export without hangs or missing assets.

epics.title: First-visit scene event triggers
epics.description: Per-scene first-visit event triggers (e.g. Naphtali intro on first Church entry). Distinct from EVENT-SYSTEM (web-compat of runtime event execution); this is about the trigger condition + event-not-yet-played gating.

epics.title: Menu navigation — WASD/keyboard consistent across all menus
epics.description: Every menu (MenuOverlay, OptionsMenu at Title, OptionsMenu at New Game, Save/Load, Items/Equipment/Skills, dialogue options, etc.) opens with the top interactable highlighted by default; up/down keys navigate to next/prev interactable button or option, skipping disabled ones; ui_accept selects. Currently partial on MenuOverlay, broken on Title→Options + New Game OptionsMenu.

epics.title: Web deploy pipeline + hosting + OTel observability
epics.description: Evergreen concern — deploy pipeline, CORS server, AppC sync, OTel/Tempo observability. Distinct from G4-MIGRATION which closes after migration done.

epics.title: Migration Phase 1: framework/game separation design
epics.description: Phase distinction preserved per owner direction.

epics.title: Migration Phase 2: Chronicles G4 conversion (packs, tests, deploy)
epics.description: Phase distinction preserved per owner direction.

epics.title: NPC Collision Tuning
epics.description: NPC collision capsule is too narrow — player can walk through or barely brush NPCs. Needs to be substantially wider (2x+) so bumping into NPCs feels natural. Three successive attempts (V1 pending_review, V2 testing, V3 testing — each wider than last).

epics.title: Event Delay Reduction — tighten all cinematic pauses
epics.description: All scene-event step delays (commandFadeIn, commandMoveTo, commandDialogue waits) are too long — stretching 1-2s steps to 4s+. Audit and tighten across all events to ~0.3-1s where feasible.

epics.title: Major Architecture Refactor — Menus, Dialogue, Event System
epics.description: Phase 0 (test baseline) → Phase 1 (MenuBase) → Phase 2 (DialogueDisplay + EventDirector). PlayerCharacter/combat explicitly out of scope. See MAJOR_REFACTOR_PLAN.md for full plan.

epics.title: Token efficiency tooling — MCP tools + skills to reduce agent dispatch cost
epics.description: Four tools: arc-mcp pre_dispatch_context (front-load findings), vera-mcp xfail_manifest (eliminate discovery), confirm-spec skill (UI gate), arc-mcp session_efficiency_report (burn visibility). See session 2026-04-29 token analysis.
